messages:
maria: Heads-up: preparing a soft-open deploy for release v1.12.3 targeting 'new-route-llm' flag. Change window 22:00-23:59 UTC. Plan: enable 2% (slow-slice) -> 10% after 15m -> 25% after another 20m if signals look good. Will pin model-version=redwood-v2-2026-03 for this cohort.
kevin: I'll own telemetry and dashboards. Watching: error-rate, 95p latency, and per-token cost. Will post thresholds in a sec.
deploy-bot: deploy v1.12.3 started, artifacts pinned: service=route-api@sha256:abc123, model=redwood-v2-2026-03. FeatureFlag:new-route-llm currently OFF.
sara: oncall here. Escalation threshold: >1% user-visible errors sustained for 5m OR 95p latency > 800ms for 5m. If hit, call a rollback and pinback. Use @oncall in channel.
dmitri: Confirming: will we use session-affinity for the 2% cohort? If not, we get noisy metrics on short-lived sessions. Recommend sticky sampling for 20m.
maria: Good call — enabling sticky sampling for the slow-slice. Plan updated: sticky sampling TTL=20m for cohorts.
kevin: Telemetry thresholds I set: error-rate alert = 0.8% (warning) / 1.2% (critical). Latency: 95p > 650ms (warning) / >800ms (critical). Token-cost spike: >30% increase vs baseline in 10m window = investigate. I'll post dashboard link: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/llm-route-new-route-llm
product-lead: Need a one-line release note for customers: "Opt-in experiment: new LLM routing improves latency for heavy prompts; gradually rolling out." Keep me posted.
maria: Release note acked. I'll attach to the release ticket after soft-open completes.
deploy-bot: feature toggle new-route-llm -> ENABLED for cohort=slow-slice-2pct (sticky=true). Timestamp=7043210025
kevin: 2% slow-slice traffic live. Initial metrics: 0.1% errors, 95p latency +40ms, token cost +4% (5m). Nothing alarming.
dmitri: telemetry looks clean. Proceeding to step to expand to 10% in 15m if no warnings.
sara: Oncall: I'm standing by for the 15m window. Reactions: :thumbsup: if we pass.
maria: expanding to 10% now. deploy-bot schedule request: enable new-route-llm cohort=slow-slice-10pct at 7043210110
deploy-bot: cohort change executed: new-route-llm -> 10% cohort applied.
kevin: 10% metrics (10m): errors 0.2%, 95p latency +60ms, token cost +6%. All within warning bounds, no criticals.
product-lead: If all green at +30m, merge release note and mark the feature as "experiment - watch" in the console.
dmitri: Quick note: keeping version pin until 24h post-rollout, then we can unpin to default model if no regressions.
sara: If any critical alerts hit, rollback action: disable flag immediately, pin traffic back to previous routing, and escalate to infra. Use this playbook: /runbook rollback-llm-route.
maria: Copy. Final step planned: 25% in 20m if still green. Will PM in 15m with final thumbs.
kevin: Dashboard link again: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/llm-route-new-route-llm (I added annotated thresholds).
deploy-bot: scheduled task: expand cohort to 25% at 7043210230.
product-lead: Thanks all — leaving watch for roll-forward decision. I'll prep the release-note PR now.
maria: closing loop: will post a short postmortem if we hit any warnings or take action. Otherwise I'll add a short note to release ticket that rollout followed plan. :white_check_mark:
